# Dashboard Creation Skill (dt-app-dashboards)

Create Dynatrace dashboards programmatically for application onboarding using the Dynatrace API.

## Dashboard JSON Structure

```json
{
  "dashboardMetadata": {
    "name": "WealthTrack Agent — Service Overview",
    "shared": true,
    "owner": "onboarding-agent",
    "tags": ["wealthtrack", "auto-generated", "nodejs"],
    "preset": false
  },
  "tiles": []
}
```

## Tile Types

### 1. Markdown Tile (header/description)
```json
{
  "name": "",
  "tileType": "MARKDOWN",
  "configured": true,
  "bounds": {"top": 0, "left": 0, "width": 1824, "height": 76},
  "markdown": "## WealthTrack Agent — Service Health Dashboard\nAuto-generated by Dynatrace Onboarding Agent"
}
```

### 2. Custom Chart Tile (DQL-powered)
```json
{
  "name": "Response Time P95 (ms)",
  "tileType": "DATA_EXPLORER",
  "configured": true,
  "bounds": {"top": 76, "left": 0, "width": 608, "height": 304},
  "queries": [{
    "id": "A",
    "spaceAggregation": "AVG",
    "timeAggregation": "DEFAULT",
    "splitBy": ["dt.entity.service"],
    "metricSelector": "builtin:service.response.time:avg:auto:sort(value(avg,descending)):limit(10)",
    "enabled": true
  }],
  "visualConfig": {
    "type": "GRAPH_CHART",
    "thresholds": [{
      "axisTarget": "LEFT", "columnId": "A",
      "rules": [
        {"color": "#7dc540", "value": 0},
        {"color": "#f5d30f", "value": 1000},
        {"color": "#dc172a", "value": 3000}
      ]
    }]
  }
}
```

### 3. Service Health Tile
```json
{
  "name": "Services",
  "tileType": "SERVICES",
  "configured": true,
  "bounds": {"top": 76, "left": 608, "width": 608, "height": 304},
  "filterConfig": {
    "type": "SERVICE",
    "customName": "WealthTrack Services",
    "defaultName": "Custom chart",
    "chartConfig": {"type": "TIMESERIES"}
  }
}
```

### 4. SLO Tile
```json
{
  "name": "API Availability SLO",
  "tileType": "SLO",
  "configured": true,
  "bounds": {"top": 76, "left": 1216, "width": 304, "height": 304},
  "assignedEntities": [],
  "metric": "FUNC:slo(\"wealthtrack-availability\")"
}
```

## Complete WealthTrack Dashboard Template

Use this template for the WealthTrack Agent onboarding dashboard:

```json
{
  "dashboardMetadata": {
    "name": "WealthTrack Agent — Monitoring Dashboard",
    "shared": true,
    "owner": "dynatrace-onboarding-agent",
    "tags": ["wealthtrack", "auto-generated", "nodejs", "financial-ai"]
  },
  "tiles": [
    {
      "name": "",
      "tileType": "MARKDOWN",
      "configured": true,
      "bounds": {"top": 0, "left": 0, "width": 1824, "height": 76},
      "markdown": "## WealthTrack Agent — Auto-Generated Monitoring Dashboard\n**Services:** wealthtrack-backend | mcp-yahoo | mcp-duckduckgo | mcp-fetcher | arize-phoenix"
    },
    {
      "name": "Response Time P95",
      "tileType": "DATA_EXPLORER",
      "configured": true,
      "bounds": {"top": 76, "left": 0, "width": 608, "height": 304},
      "queries": [{
        "id": "A", "spaceAggregation": "AVG", "timeAggregation": "DEFAULT",
        "splitBy": ["dt.entity.service"],
        "metricSelector": "builtin:service.response.time:percentile(95):auto:sort(value(avg,descending)):limit(5)",
        "enabled": true
      }]
    },
    {
      "name": "Error Rate %",
      "tileType": "DATA_EXPLORER",
      "configured": true,
      "bounds": {"top": 76, "left": 608, "width": 608, "height": 304},
      "queries": [{
        "id": "A", "spaceAggregation": "AVG", "timeAggregation": "DEFAULT",
        "splitBy": ["dt.entity.service"],
        "metricSelector": "builtin:service.errors.total.rate:avg:auto:sort(value(avg,descending)):limit(5)",
        "enabled": true
      }]
    },
    {
      "name": "Node.js Heap Usage",
      "tileType": "DATA_EXPLORER",
      "configured": true,
      "bounds": {"top": 76, "left": 1216, "width": 608, "height": 304},
      "queries": [{
        "id": "A", "spaceAggregation": "AVG", "timeAggregation": "DEFAULT",
        "splitBy": ["dt.entity.process_group_instance"],
        "metricSelector": "builtin:tech.nodejs.v8HeapUsed:avg:auto",
        "enabled": true
      }]
    }
  ]
}
```

## Dynatrace API for Dashboard CRUD

```
POST /api/v1/config/dashboards          — create dashboard
GET  /api/v1/config/dashboards          — list dashboards
GET  /api/v1/config/dashboards/{id}     — get dashboard
PUT  /api/v1/config/dashboards/{id}     — update dashboard
DELETE /api/v1/config/dashboards/{id}   — delete dashboard
```

Headers: `Authorization: Api-Token {DT_API_TOKEN}`, `Content-Type: application/json`

## Alert Rule (Metric Events API)

```json
{
  "metadata": {"configurationVersions": [1], "clusterVersion": "1.0"},
  "id": null,
  "type": "METRIC_THRESHOLD",
  "name": "WealthTrack — High Response Time",
  "description": "Alert when P95 response time exceeds 3000ms",
  "metricId": "builtin:service.response.time",
  "aggregationType": "PERCENTILE_95",
  "severity": "PERFORMANCE",
  "alertCondition": "ABOVE",
  "threshold": 3000000,
  "violatingSamples": 3,
  "samples": 5,
  "dealertingSamples": 5,
  "enabled": true,
  "scopes": []
}
```

Alert threshold unit: **microseconds** for response time (3000ms = 3000000 µs)
